description: Defines an internal class InternalGrainRuntime that provides shared runtime services for grains in Orleans. The class holds references to other components such as MessageCenter, Catalog, GrainVersionManifest, and various interfaces related to grain directory, messaging, and options.

classes.name: InternalGrainRuntime
classes.description: An internal class that exposes shared grain runtime services such as message center, catalog, version manifest, messaging trace, grain locator, and options related to grain collection and directory.

methods.name: <constructor>
methods.description: Initializes the InternalGrainRuntime with references to core runtime services and components.
